pages.title: Hyperdimensional Die
pages.text: A die that is larger on the inside. Its circuitry extends through a hidden dimension, so it holds far more logic than its visible area. Turning it over, I sometimes see traces on the back that were not there before.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Dicing a Hyperdimensional Logic Wafer in the Planck-Scale Cutter, I found each die kept its fourth-dimensional depth. The interior still held more logic than the surface could account for.
Made in $(item)Planck-Scale Cutter$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Hyperdimensional Geometry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Hyperdimensional Processor.
